## What changed

Describe the focused change and its user or operator impact.

## Why

Explain the problem, root cause when applicable, and important tradeoffs.

## Evidence

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] Relevant unit or integration tests
- [ ] UI behavior checked at desktop and mobile sizes when applicable
- [ ] Documentation or ADR updated when the contract changed

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated browser artifacts, or backups are included
- [ ] Tenant authorization and immutable revision boundaries remain enforced
- [ ] New dependencies have a compatible license and a clear purpose
